compiled_state.title: UPDATE: merge-to-main-pr.sh + merge-to-main-direct.sh — eliminate MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Eliminate MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE env var from merge-to-main-pr.sh and merge-to-main-direct.sh.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (remove export MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE at line 2165, unset at 2167)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh (remove the MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE=1 check at line 616)
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh and test-merge-to-main.sh (update any tests that set or assert MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE)

## Implementation Analysis
merge-to-main-pr.sh: The export/unset of MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE signals to child scripts (like merge-to-main-direct.sh called as a subprocess) that they're in PR mode. After S5, merge-to-main.sh routes ci-pr → exec merge-to-main-pr.sh and local → exec merge-to-main-direct.sh. So merge-to-main-direct.sh is only called in local mode, meaning MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE=1 should never be set when it runs.

**Change to merge-to-main-pr.sh:**
- Remove `export MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE=1` (line 2165) and `unset MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE` (line 2167)
- If there are other places in merge-to-main-pr.sh that call merge-to-main-direct.sh as a subprocess (not via exec), identify them and replace the env var signal with dso.workflow=ci-pr config check directly in that script

**Change to merge-to-main-direct.sh:**
- Remove the MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE=1 check at line 616
- If the block at 616 is needed in ci-pr mode, replace with direct dso.workflow=ci-pr check

## Note
If the MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE check in merge-to-main-direct.sh is required for correct behavior (e.g., different commit strategy in PR mode), add a direct dso.workflow read instead of eliminating the behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE not referenced in either script
  Verify: ! grep -q 'MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh passes (smoke test routing behavior)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh

On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
